verdicts.reason: A: the date card, which was a key element, has shrunk to an unreadable thumbnail with illegible eyebrow text beside the logo. The decorative strip is blown up into a huge cropped panel that takes up half the canvas, and the body copy is tiny, crammed next to the controller. B keeps a strong headline, a clear CTA and readable body copy, but the date card is too small (its time text is illegible), the logo pill crowds the eyebrow and the date card, and the cropped pattern strip sits tight under the CTA, leaving the top cluster cramped.
